route_correctness.definition: Share of turns where observed policy action and call control match the expected full-scenario route.

policy_action_correctness.definition: Share of turns where the observed policy action matches the expected route action.

call_control_correctness.definition: Share of turns where call control matches the expected continue, handoff, end, schedule, or sale-ready control.

scenario_route_pass_rate.definition: Share of full scenarios where every turn stayed on the expected route.

non_sale_correctness.definition: Share of non-sale turns that avoid close controls and payment collection.

safe_close_correctness.definition: Share of sale-ready or callback turns that avoid payment collection.

discovery_before_close_rate.definition: Share of turns where the answer asks a focused question or uses a correct terminal control.

emotion_handling_score.definition: Share of turns where the answer acknowledges, handles boundary safely, or routes appropriately.

hard_failure_rate.definition: Share of scenarios with payment, validation, forbidden-text, language, or unsafe-close hard failures.

leakage_failure_rate.definition: Share of scenarios with leakage findings; PROD-027 inherits PROD-014 pattern-bank leakage boundaries and stores no source text.
